title: Part-Time Research & HubSpot Data Assistant
description:
RazorPitch is looking for a detail-oriented researcher to build and maintain our stock-promotion vendor database and improve the accuracy of our HubSpot contacts. You should be comfortable moving between online research, social platforms, spreadsheets and HubSpot, and be able to separate verified facts from claims.



Vendor discovery and campaign tracking

• Find vendors, creators, publishers and distribution services that offer paid promotion of small-cap, microcap and penny stocks across Reddit,
, Instagram, TikTok,
/X, Stocktwits,
 newsletters, SMS lists, mobile apps and push notifications.

• Document each vendor’s name, websites and account links, channels, business contact details, services, audience figures and available pricing. Record the source and date checked, and label vendor-reported figures and unconfirmed information clearly.

• Follow approved accounts and subscribe to approved newsletters or alerts using dedicated research accounts,
 addresses and phone numbers. Use pseudonyms only where permitted by the platform; do not impersonate another person or invent credentials, affiliations or investment activity.

• Log observed promotions with the company or ticker, platform, date, source link or permitted screenshot, and relevant compensation disclosures. Record who was paid, by whom and how much only when disclosed. Do not label ordinary stock commentary as paid promotion without supporting evidence.

• After the initial database is built, review assigned vendors and feeds 2–3 times per week. Add new activity, verify existing details, flag inactive accounts and duplicates, and keep last-checked dates current.



HubSpot enrichment and LinkedIn

• Research current CEOs, CFOs and investor-relations contacts for assigned public companies. Verify names, titles, company affiliations, business
 addresses, phone numbers and LinkedIn profile URLs using company websites, filings, official IR pages and approved research tools.

• Update the correct HubSpot company and contact records using the established process. Check for duplicates, record sources and verification dates, distinguish direct numbers from switchboards, and separate published or tool-validated
s from guessed addresses. Leave unresolved details flagged rather than presenting them as verified.

• Prepare relevant LinkedIn connection opportunities and, when authorized, send connection requests or approved messages through a genuine, permitted account. Keep outreach status in HubSpot, respect opt-outs and platform limits, and flag replies for the appropriate team member.



What good work looks like

Accurate, traceable records; useful coverage of the assigned vendor list; current HubSpot contacts; and a short weekly summary of additions, changes, missing information and items needing a decision. Quality matters more than filling every field or producing inflated activity counts.



Experience we are looking for

Hands-on HubSpot experience; strong web and social-media research; contact enrichment and verification; organized spreadsheet/database work; clear written English; and sound judgment about privacy, source quality and platform rules. Familiarity with public companies, stock tickers, investor relations or financial newsletters is helpful.



Schedule, pay and application

Part-time, remote and flexible, with 10 paid hours per week at US$6–$8 per hour depending on experience. Research may be completed during your local daytime, with agreed deadlines and 2–3 weekly maintenance check-ins once the initial setup is complete. We will start with a small vendor/contact batch to assess accuracy and the time required before expanding the assigned workload.



To apply, share your research and HubSpot experience, a brief example of how you verify contact or vendor information, familiarity with the platforms above, weekly availability and expected hourly rate. Do not include confidential information from another employer.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter: Roofing Owners, Free Audit Offer (Bring Your Own Dialer and A2P Setup)
description:
About Curavia Studio:

Curavia Studio is a young marketing studio in Bloomington, Indiana, serving roofing companies in the Indianapolis market. We build and run lead follow-up and appointment booking systems for roofers: ads on the client's own account, every lead answered in under five minutes, booking on the client's calendar, review requests, and a weekly report. We are honest about our stage: we are signing our first founding roofing partners now, and this hire is part of how we reach them. You would be our first acquisition setter, working directly with the founder's team.



The job:

You sell conversations, not services. Your work is reaching roofing company owners and offering them two free things: a personalized audit of how their company captures and follows up leads (theirs to keep either way), and a short recorded demo of our system working on a real test lead. When an owner says yes, you book a free 15 to 30 minute growth call on our calendar. That is the win. You never pitch our price and you never close a sale; the decision happens later, in writing, without you on the line.



- Outbound calls to roofing owners from lists we provide (Indianapolis area first), working from a short written audit we prepare for each company

- Paced participation in roofing owner
 groups from our real business presence: helpful posts, real answers, conversations that end at the free audit offer

- DM follow-up with owners who engaged, inside our follow-up rules (one polite follow-up, then silence)

- Book calls on our calendar through our booking link and log every touch in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day

- Route any price, terms, or objection question to our team the same day instead of improvising an answer



A hard requirement of this seat: your own calling setup.

You call on your own dialer and your own A2P-registered numbers, with your own compliance registration in good standing. Our own phone registration is still in process, which is exactly why this seat is structured this way. If you do not already have a working dialer and registered numbers you control, this posting is not for you. In your application, describe your setup in your own words (see the application questions). We will ask about it again in the interview.



Hours:

- Part time, about 20 hours per week, scheduled in US Eastern Time calling windows (our owners are in Indiana, and owners answer before crews roll and after jobs wrap)

- Reliability matters more than volume: the windows you commit to are the windows you work



Requirements:

- Filipino VA working from home (this posting is for direct hire via OnlineJobs.ph)

- Excellent spoken English: roofing owners, often on a job site with noise around them, must understand you easily on the first pass. Written English must be clean enough for DMs an owner would forward to a partner

- A working dialer and A2P-registered numbers that you own or control, in good standing, described concretely in your application

- Prior outbound appointment-setting experience; roofing, home-services, or other contractor outbound experience is a strong plus

- Quiet workspace, good USB headset, reliable high-speed internet, and a backup connection plan you can describe

- Comfortable in a CRM: every touch logged the same day. GoHighLevel experience is a plus, any CRM discipline helps

- Comfortable being recorded and reviewed: our team listens to call recordings for coaching and quality

- Available to start within one week of an offer, and looking for a long-term seat



Pay (performance-based, stated exactly):

- $50 for every Qualified Show, capped at $500 per calendar month. A Qualified Show means: the owner or a decision maker of a roofing company in our target market attends the Free Growth Call you booked (a real attendance of at least 15 minutes), the booking was made by you and logged in our CRM before the call, and the company was not already in conversation with Curavia before your first touch. A booking alone is not a show. A no-show is not a show.

- Plus 5% of cash collected on clients whose first Qualified Show you booked: 5% of the Curavia fees that client actually pays and that clear (the buildout start and the monthly partnership payments). Client ad spend never counts; it is never ours. Paid after the client's payment clears, on the weekly pay cycle, 7 days after the underlying cash clears.

- Worked example, so there is no mystery: you book a show, the owner becomes a client, and Curavia collects a $300 buildout start plus the first $1,500 monthly payment, $1,800 total. You receive the $50 show fee plus $90 (5% of $1,800), $140 for that client, subject to the monthly show cap.

- If a client payment you were paid on is later refunded or reversed, the matching fee or percentage is reversed in the same proportion.

- There is no hourly base in these terms. Your income is tied to shows that happen and clients who pay, and we would rather state that plainly here than surprise you later.



How to apply: Answer every application question in this posting, in your own words. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a voice recording and a live interview with a role-play. Copy-paste applications are deleted unread.



Application Screening Questions:

1. Your calling setup, in your own words. Name your dialer. Where do your numbers come from? How does your A2P registration work, and how do you handle opt-outs, do-not-call requests, and call recording consent? Be concrete: we are hiring this seat partly because the setup is yours, and we need to understand exactly what we are relying on.

2. How many outbound dials have you sustained per day in past roles, and in what industries? What did a normal shift look like?

3. Have you done outbound calling for roofing, home-services, or other contractor companies? Describe the offer you were setting appointments for.

4. Record a 30 to 60 second voice note introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this role, and attach or link it with your application.

5. Written pitch exercise. Write the first 3 sentences of a call to a roofing owner whose company you have never spoken to. You are offering a free audit of how his company captures and follows up leads. Write exactly what you would say, word for word. (We read this more closely than anything else in your application.)

6. An owner says: "Not interested. Do not call me again." Walk us through exactly what you do in the next 60 seconds, and exactly what you log in the CRM afterward.

7. Part of this seat is paced participation in roofing owner
 groups from our real business account: helpful posts, genuine answers, no spam, no extra profiles. Have you done community or group-based outreach before? Describe how you worked and what pace you kept.

8. Our owners are in Indiana (US Eastern Time). This seat is about 20 hours per week in Eastern calling windows. Which windows can you reliably cover every week, in Philippine time?

9. Describe your internet setup (provider, typical speed), your backup plan when it fails, your workspace, and your headset.

10. This seat pays per qualified show plus a percentage of collected client fees, with no hourly base. Have you worked performance pay before? Are you genuinely comfortable with it? When could you start, and are you looking for long-term work?

title: Senior Painting Estimator / Lead QA Reviewer — US Commercial Takeoffs (Long-Term, Per-Project)
description:
Premium Takeoff is an estimating studio producing overnight quantity takeoffs for US commercial painting and finishes contractors (Texas, Florida, Arizona). Contractors send plan sets in the US evening; we return bid-ready, senior-reviewed takeoffs the next US morning. We are hiring ONE senior painting estimator to become our Lead QA Reviewer for Division 09 — long-term, 100% per-project work. No salary, no fixed schedule: you are paid for every job, at rates agreed in writing before you start.



THE ROLE

- First paid assignment: build our master painting takeoff template + QA checklist with us (one fixed fee, agreed upfront).

- After that: review takeoffs produced by our bench estimators before delivery — verify quantities on the value-driving line items, scales, specifications, finish schedules and addenda — correct, note your assumptions, and sign off. Volume grows month over month; your rates are set per job by plan-set size (small / medium / large / XL).



REQUIREMENTS (all mandatory)

- 5+ years estimating US commercial painting / finishes (CSI Division 09) from full plan sets + specifications.

- PlanSwift AND Bluebeam Revu used daily. Holding your OWN active licenses is a strong asset — tell us what you have.

- You read specs, finish schedules and ADDENDA, and you catch scope changes. Reviewing = hunting errors, not re-measuring everything.

- Available Philippine night hours so deliverables land by US morning (Eastern), with stable internet + a backup plan.

- Clear written English: your review notes and assumptions/exclusions lists go in front of US contractors.



HOW TO APPLY — follow exactly, or your application is deleted unread:

1. Start your reply with: LEAD REVIEWER — DIV 09

2. Answer these 6 screening questions (short answers, your own words):

Q1. Mid-takeoff, you find the PDF scale on a sheet doesn't match the stated scale. What do you do, in order?

Q2. The finish schedule and the architectural plans disagree on which rooms get painted. Which document wins, and what do you do?

Q3. Addendum 2 arrives after you've finished 80% of a takeoff and changes the finish schedule in 6 rooms. Walk me through your next 30 minutes.

Q4. Do you measure ceilings for paint by default?

Q5. A spec calls for 1 primer + 2 finish coats on GWB walls. What exactly do you count and report?

Q6. How do you handle doors and hollow-metal frames in a painting takeoff?

3. Attach or link ONE sample of a takeoff YOU produced (client names and prices may be redacted — quantities and format only).

4. State your rate expectations: your price per review by plan-set size, and your fixed price for the template + checklist build.



Screening is by your answers + sample only. There is NO paid test: the first money you earn is your first real job with us.
salary: Per project — rates by project size, agr

title: SEO & PPC Marketing Manager
description:
SEO & PPC Marketing Manager — Part Time to Full Time Growth Opportunity



Company: Liquid Liabilities LLC  

Industry: U.S. Real Estate Investment  

Location: Remote — Philippines  

Employment: Part-Time, with opportunity for Full-Time advancement  

Starting Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week  

Starting Compensation: $8–$12 USD/hour, based on demonstrated experience



About Our Company



Liquid Liabilities LLC is a U.S.-based real estate investment company focused on helping homeowners understand their property selling options and make informed decisions.



We are developing a long term digital marketing strategy built around two primary objectives:



1. Generate Qualified Seller Leads Now



Attract homeowners actively considering selling their properties and convert interested visitors into qualified seller inquiries through our Fair Cash Offer page.



2. Build Trust and Long Term Relationships



Establish Liquid Liabilities LLC as a trusted first point of contact for homeowners researching property selling options, even if they are not ready to sell immediately.



We want our website to provide valuable information, establish credibility, and encourage homeowners to contact us when they need guidance or are ready to sell.



The Opportunity



We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and self directed SEO & PPC Marketing Manager to take ownership of our digital search marketing.



We currently have Google Ads campaigns running and an established website that we want to improve.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We need someone who understands digital marketing strategy and can independently manage both paid advertising and organic search optimization.



The position starts part time, with opportunities for increased hours, compensation, and eventual full time marketing leadership as the company grows.



Key Responsibilities



1. Google Ads & PPC Management



- Audit and optimize existing Google Ads Search campaigns.

- Develop keyword strategies that attract homeowners actively considering selling.

- Research high-intent seller keywords and relevant property selling situations.

- Manage negative keywords, search terms, bidding, ad copy, and approved budgets.

- Reduce wasted advertising spending while improving qualified seller lead generation.

- Monitor campaign results and continuously test improvements.

- Ensure advertising follows applicable Google Ads policies and restrictions.



2. Search Engine Optimization



- Develop and execute a long-term SEO strategy.

- Conduct keyword research covering immediate selling intent and earlier-stage homeowner questions.

- Improve technical, on page, and local SEO.

- Optimize website content, page structure, titles, internal links, and organic search visibility.

- Develop helpful, accurate, and trustworthy content about homeowners' property selling options.

- Identify new website pages and educational content opportunities.

- Improve search visibility for relevant U.S. markets.

- Follow sustainable, search engine compliant SEO practices.



3. Website Conversion Optimization



- Analyze the customer journey from search results to website inquiries.

- Improve the Fair Cash Offer landing page's conversion performance.

- Evaluate homepage messaging, trust signals, and calls to action.

- Identify opportunities to increase qualified inquiries while preserving the website's existing lead-capture functionality.

- Recommend and implement approved improvements to landing pages and website content.

- Ensure both immediate sellers and homeowners seeking information can easily find an appropriate next step.



4. Analytics, Tracking & Lead Quality



- Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.

- Verify and maintain Google Ads conversion tracking.

- Measure actual lead submissions, not just clicks or website visits.

- Track leads originating from paid advertising and organic search.

- Help distinguish qualified homeowner inquiries from irrelevant traffic.

- Evaluate cost per lead, cost per qualified lead, conversion rates, and organic search performance.

- Provide accurate, understandable performance reports.



5. Marketing Strategy & Accountability



- Develop a prioritized 30, 60, and 90 day marketing plan.

- Independently organize and execute approved marketing activities.

- Provide weekly progress and performance reports.

- Identify problems, recommend solutions, and explain the expected business impact.

- Work within approved advertising and software budgets.

- Obtain company approval before significant spending or website changes.



Required Qualifications



- Proven hands on experience managing Google Ads Search campaigns.

- Strong understanding of technical, on page, and local SEO.

- Experience generating qualified leads for U.S. businesses.

- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.

- Experience optimizing websites and landing pages for conversions.

- Strong keyword research, copywriting, and analytical skills.

- Ability to independently plan, execute, and evaluate marketing campaigns.

- Excellent written English and clear communication.

- Reliable, organized, proactive, and results oriented.



Preferred Experience



- U.S. real estate investment or motivated homeowner lead generation.

- Local service business marketing.

- Google Ads policies affecting housing and sensitive personal situations.

- Website optimization, basic HTML, and conversion tracking.

- CRM integration and lead attribution.



Compensation & Career Growth



Starting compensation is $8–$12 USD/hour, based on experience and demonstrated capabilities.



The position initially requires approximately 15 hours per week, with responsibilities prioritized to fit the agreed schedule.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term career with the company.



As the business grows, successful candidates may receive increased hours, compensation reviews, expanded responsibilities, and opportunities to transition into a full time management position.



Exceptional long-term performers may eventually advance into senior marketing leadership roles with compensation potential of up to $5,000 USD per month.



Future compensation increases and promotions depend on sustained performance, expanded responsibilities, company growth, and mutual agreement. They are not guaranteed.



How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction and your resume.

2. Your years of hands on SEO and Google Ads experience.

3. Two examples of successful campaigns or SEO projects you personally managed, including measurable results.

4. Your experience generating qualified leads for U.S. businesses.

5. Your experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Search Console.

6. Your desired hourly rate and weekly availability.



Required Application Question:



Our real estate investment company wants to generate qualified homeowner leads immediately through Google Ads and our Fair Cash Offer page, while also building long-term trust and organic traffic through SEO.



How would you prioritize and manage both objectives during your first 90 days, working approximately 15 hours per week?



We are seeking someone who thinks strategically, takes ownership, communicates clearly, and wants to grow with our company.



Liquid Liabilities LLC

 new leads from our website and

title: Senior YouTube Video Editor – Golf Entertainment Series (Long-Form + Shorts)
description:
Senior YouTube Video Editor & Motion Graphics Specialist – Golf Entertainment Series



Job Type: Gig / Project-Based (Potential Long-Term Opportunity)

Location: Remote

Project Duration: 10-Episode Season



About the Project



Lakeland Golf Club is launching The Club Golf Sim League, a new YouTube golf entertainment series filmed in the United States.



Think Bob Does Sports meets Barstool Sports and the Internet Invitational.



The show features 12 golfers competing in a golf simulator league, with plenty of trash talk, comedy, rivalries, and competitive moments.



We’re looking for a talented, creative, and experienced YouTube Video Editor & Motion Graphics Specialist to help bring this series to life.



This isn’t a traditional corporate editing job. We want someone who understands YouTube entertainment, comedic timing, storytelling, sports graphics, and how to keep viewers engaged throughout longer videos.



We’re starting with a 10-episode season. If the series is successful and we work well together, there is an opportunity for continued projects and future seasons.



Project Scope



Season 1 Deliverables:



* 10 professionally edited YouTube episodes (40–60 minutes each)

* 100 short-form videos (10 per episode, approximately 60–90 seconds each)

* Custom animated golf scorecards, leaderboards, and sponsor graphics

* Professional audio enhancement, color grading, and sound design

* Fully editable project files for all completed work



Total: 110 finished videos.



Raw Footage & Show Format



Each episode features two separate 9-hole golf matches.



Each match includes six golfers competing on three teams of two using an alternate-shot format.



We will provide approximately:



* 3 hours of footage from Camera 1 (active golfer)

* 3 hours of footage from Camera 2 (other golfers and reactions)

* 3 hours of GSPro golf simulator gameplay recorded through OBS



That’s approximately nine hours of synchronized footage from a three-hour filming session per episode.



The editor will need to review the footage, identify entertaining moments, and create a polished episode that combines competitive golf with comedy and personality-driven storytelling.



Responsibilities



Long-Form YouTube Editing



* Edit 40–60-minute YouTube episodes with engaging pacing and storytelling

* Synchronize multiple camera angles and gameplay recordings

* Highlight funny conversations, trash talk, reactions, great shots, and terrible shots

* Create engaging introductions, transitions, and episode endings

* Incorporate music, sound effects, replays, zoom-ins, and comedic effects

* Maintain continuity of team scores, league standings, and ongoing storylines



Golf Graphics & Motion Design



Create professional, reusable graphics, including:



* Animated golf scorecards displayed during swings

* Full leaderboards at the conclusion of each hole

* Player and team introduction graphics

* Weekly league standings

* Hole transitions and matchup graphics

* Playoff brackets and championship animations

* Picture-in-picture GSPro gameplay overlays

* Sponsor-branded graphics and replay segments



We want graphics with a polished sports-broadcast feel similar to the Internet Invitational.



Sponsor Integrations



The series will feature recurring sponsor placements, including:



* Shot of the Week

* Choke of the Week

* Official Scorecard Sponsor

* Par 3 Sponsor

* League / Championship Sponsor

* Major-Week Giveaways

* Food Sponsor

* Slice of the Week



You’ll be responsible for incorporating sponsor logos, animations, replay graphics, and promotional segments into the episodes.



Short-Form Video Editing



Produce 10 short-form videos from each episode.



Each Short should:



* Be approximately 60–90 seconds

* Be formatted vertically (9:16)

* Include engaging hooks and professional captions

* Feature dynamic editing, zoom-ins, and sound effects where appropriate

* Highlight funny moments, golf shots, reactions, and rivalries

* Be ready for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and TikTok



We want someone who understands what makes short-form content entertaining and shareable.



Audio & Video Enhancement



* Professional color correction and grading

* Consistent color matching between cameras

* Dialogue enhancement and noise reduction

* Audio leveling and mixing

* Background music and sound effects

* Final mastering for YouTube



Our filming location has a dark, luxury speakeasy atmosphere. We want to preserve that aesthetic while maintaining clear, professional-looking footage.



Required Skills



* Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong experience with Adobe After Effects

* Professional YouTube video editing

* Motion graphics and animation

* Multicamera editing and synchronization

* Audio enhancement and mixing

* Color grading

* Short-form video editing

* Strong storytelling and comedic timing

* Ability to meet weekly deadlines

* Good written English communication



Experience editing golf, sports, gaming, or entertainment YouTube channels is a major advantage.



Important: Editable Project Files Required



We have in-house editors who may need to make changes to episodes, graphics, or sponsor placements.



For this reason, we require:



* Fully editable Premiere Pro project files

* After Effects files and reusable graphics templates

* Organized timelines and project folders

* Linked media and supporting assets

* Editable scorecards, leaderboards, and sponsor graphics

* Complete project handoff with each finished episode



We must be able to open and revise the projects independently.



Please do not apply if you can only provide finished MP4 exports.



Compensation & Project Structure



This is a paid, project-based opportunity, not an immediate full-time position.



We’re looking to hire someone for the first 10-episode season, with the possibility of ongoing work if the series performs well.



We’re open to negotiating a fair project rate based on experience, portfolio quality, and the full scope of work.



The entire season is 10 weeks and here is what we will need accomplished:



1. One complete pilot episode (40–60 minutes)

2. A package of 10 long-form episodes

3. A package of 100 short-form videos

4. Initial graphics and animation template development



We prefer to work with one editor or a small editing team that can handle both long-form and short-form production.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio



Share links to your best YouTube editing projects. Golf, sports, comedy, and entertainment content are especially relevant.



2. Motion Graphics Examples



Show examples of animated scoreboards, sports graphics, leaderboards, or similar projects you’ve created.



3. Software Experience



Confirm your experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.



4. Availability



Let us know your expected turnaround time for a 40–60-minute episode and 10 Shorts.



5. Project File Delivery



Confirm that all editable project files, animations, and supporting assets will be provided.



6. Creative Approach



Briefly explain how you would approach editing a golf entertainment show that combines competitive gameplay, comedy, and reality-show-style storytelling.



To confirm you’ve read the full posting, start your application with the words “THE CLUB.”



Our Goal



We’re not simply looking for someone to cut video clips together.



We’re looking for a creative editing partner who understands storytelling, humor, competition, and YouTube audience retention.



Our goal is to build a golf entertainment series that people genuinely look forward to watching every week.



If you’re passionate about video editing and want to help build a new entertainment brand from the beginning, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Video Editor – Instagram Reels & YouTube Long-Form



About Us



We are an online business coaching company focused on helping aspiring entrepreneurs build and scale online businesses. We are looking for talented, creative, and detail-oriented video editors to help us produce high-quality content across Instagram and YouTube.



Our content revolves around entrepreneurship, business education, online business models, and coaching.

Position Overview



We are hiring video editors for two different content formats. Depending on your skills and experience, you may be responsible for one or both positions.



1. Instagram Reels Editor



You will be responsible for editing short-form Instagram content, primarily talking-head videos where we discuss business concepts, share advice, teach strategies, and communicate with our audience.



We want a modern, fast-paced, visually engaging editing style.



Responsibilities:

- Edit short-form Instagram Reels from raw talking-head footage.

- Add dynamic captions and animated subtitles.

- Incorporate motion graphics, animations, and visual effects.

- Use relevant B-roll, stock footage, images, and other visual elements to reinforce what is being discussed.

- Add sound effects, background music, and transitions where appropriate.

- Create visually engaging hooks and maintain audience retention.

- Follow current social media editing trends and produce content with a premium, polished aesthetic.

- Deliver videos formatted and optimized for Instagram Reels.



Desired Editing Style:

- Modern, minimalist, and aesthetically pleasing.

- Fast-paced editing with minimal unnecessary pauses.

- High-quality animations and motion graphics.

- Dynamic captions and text overlays.

- Strategic zoom-ins, cuts, and transitions.

- Relevant B-roll and visual storytelling.

- Professional, premium-looking visuals.



2. Long-Form YouTube Video Editor



You will be responsible for editing long-form YouTube videos covering online business, entrepreneurship, coaching, marketing, sales, and business strategies.



We want someone who understands YouTube content creation, storytelling, and audience retention.



Responsibilities:

- Edit long-form YouTube videos from raw footage.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, mistakes, and dead space.

- Add relevant B-roll, animations, graphics, and visual elements.

- Incorporate screenshots, examples, images, and supporting footage when relevant.

- Add professional transitions, sound design, and background music.

- Create engaging visual sequences that complement the information being presented.

- Maintain a consistent editing style and professional aesthetic.

- Optimize pacing and storytelling to maximize viewer retention.



Desired Editing Style:

- Modern, clean, and professional.

- Engaging pacing without excessive or distracting editing.

- High-quality motion graphics and animations.

- Strategic B-roll and visual storytelling.

- Professional sound design.

- Minimalist but visually interesting.



Compensation



We offer competitive per-video compensation, with room for negotiation depending on your experience, editing ability, and quality of work.



Our initial compensation structure is:



- Instagram Reel: $3 per video.

- YouTube Long-Form Video: $20 per video.



Compensation is negotiable for highly skilled editors.



We are interested in building long-term relationships with talented editors and providing consistent work to the right candidates.



Requirements



- Strong experience editing Instagram Reels, YouTube videos, or both.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

- Strong understanding of modern social media editing styles.

- Ability to create engaging animations, captions, motion graphics, and visual effects.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to follow editing instructions and meet deadlines.

- Good communication skills and responsiveness.

- Ability to work independently and consistently deliver high-quality content.



We care more about your actual editing ability and portfolio than your educational background or certifications.



Trial Phase



Before officially joining our team, selected applicants will complete a short editing trial.



We will provide you with two Instagram Reels and ask you to edit them according to our preferred editing style and guidelines.



If we like the quality of your work, we will pay you for the completed trial edits and onboard you onto our team for ongoing work.



This gives both parties an opportunity to evaluate the quality of the work and determine whether we are a good fit for a long-term working relationship.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

2. Your portfolio showcasing your best work.

3. Examples of Instagram Reels or short-form content you have edited.

4. Examples of long-form YouTube videos you have edited, if applicable.

5. Which position you are interested in: Instagram Reels Editor, YouTube Long-Form Editor, or Both.

6. Your expected compensation per Instagram Reel and per YouTube video.

title: True Crime Bodycam FOIA Researcher (Long-Term)
description:
DO NOT APPLY unless you have at least 1 year of real FOIA / US public records experience. You will be asked for proof.



About the role

I’m launching a new YouTube channel producing long-form (30-45 minute) true crime documentaries built on police bodycam, dashcam, interrogation, and 911 audio. I need an experienced researcher who can find strong cases and get the footage released. I want to start right away and may hire 1-2 researchers.



Required



1+ year of real FOIA / public records experience. General internet research doesn’t qualify.

Proof of that experience: screenshots of submitted requests or agency correspondence, confirmation
s, a redacted tracking spreadsheet, footage you obtained, or a reference who can verify your work. Redact anything sensitive.

Applications without proof won’t be considered. I may ask a follow-up about one of your requests (agency, timeline, outcome).



Preferred



Experience obtaining bodycam or dashcam footage

Experience supplying footage to bodycam or true crime YouTube channels, especially larger ones

Familiarity with MuckRock or similar platforms



What you’ll do



Find strong cases. Focus on predator cases and murder investigations: long, story-driven cases with bodycam plus interrogation, 911 audio, or dashcam, and enough material for a 30-45 minute video. Skip DUIs, routine traffic stops, and short or minor incidents.

File requests. Identify the correct agency and submit requests for bodycam, dashcam, 911/dispatch audio, interrogation recordings, and incident reports. Some states limit requests to residents, so tell me up front when that applies.

Follow up. Track each request (date, agency, confirmation number, status, cost) and chase delays.

Review and hand off. Confirm the footage matches the incident, note key timestamps, write a short summary, and deliver organized, clearly named folders to my editor.



For each case, deliver: title, date and location, agency, short summary, source links, request details and confirmation number, status, estimated cost, and final files with timestamps.



Ground rules



Use only legitimate, verifiable sources. Never invent incident details, case numbers, or contacts.

Never misrepresent your identity or purpose in a request. Requests are filed under your name.

No duplicate requests without approval.

Get my approval before agreeing to any agency fee. Approved fees are reimbursed.

Flag cases involving minors, sexual-assault victims, or restricted records before filing.

Case research and compiled files are for my channel only.

Keep channel plans and materials confidential.

Flag delays, redactions, and unexpected costs right away.



Long-term: If you communicate well and deliver on time, I intend to keep working with you for months. I’ll review your first 3 cases with you. I don’t expect perfection, just steady improvement.

Starting with several cases per month, with more as the channel grows.

Updates via Upwork messages weekly. Footage delivered via Google Drive.

title: Sales Call Partner for an AI Automation Agency (Part-Time, Hourly + Commission)
description:
About us

Meta Know Labs is a small US AI automation team: Devon and three AI architects. We build AI receptionists, AI agents and automation (n8n, GoHighLevel, VAPI, Retell) for service businesses like law firms, clinics and real estate teams. Devon is Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score across 50 projects.



The role

We need a talker. Devon and our team build everything, and on calls Devon is the listener and writer: he types and collects everything as the conversation happens. You are the voice. You lead the conversation, keep it moving, fill the quiet moments, give the client feedback, and make them comfortable enough to hire us. You don't need to know how to build anything. We do the building.



How a call works

- Before every call, you get a call brief: who the client is, what they want, what we've already told them and what we still need to learn. We give you everything you need to talk about it.

- We introduce you to every client before the call, so they expect you.

- Devon opens: introductions, who we are and what we've built.

- When the conversation turns to the client's own work, you lead. That means discovery, their problems, their screen shares, and any time they ask "what do you think?" You dig into their problems with them and keep the call from going quiet.

- When a question gets specific or technical, you tell the client we'll answer it carefully in writing after the call. Devon sends every written answer.

- Before the call ends, you ask for the next step, and Devon confirms what comes next in writing.



What you don't do

- Build anything or write proposals

- Promise prices, timelines or results Devon hasn't approved



Schedule

Calls happen Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Eastern time. That's currently 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM Philippine time, Tuesday to Saturday, overnight for you. You join only the calls we book, a few hours a week to start, plus about 30 minutes to study the brief before each call.



Pay

Hourly, for call time and brief study:

- $3 per hour in your first month (trial)

- $3.50 per hour in months 2 to 4

- $4 per hour from month 5



Commission, on clients who sign after calls you were on:

- 5% of what the client pays us in their first 90 days, after platform fees, for fixed-price and hourly work alike

- 10% if you brought the client to us yourself

- Paid with your next pay after each client payment reaches us, with no cap

Example: a client pays us $2,000 in their first 90 days, and you earn $100 on top of your hourly pay.



We're early and still filling the calendar, and we'd rather say that upfront. If this works, it grows into a bigger sales role.



You're a fit if

- You speak clear, natural English and are comfortable on camera

- You stay steady under pressure and don't stumble when a client puts you on the spot

- You've sold a service on calls before, ideally software, marketing or agency services

- You can study a brief and talk about it with confidence

- You ask questions before you pitch, and silence doesn't rattle you

- You have reliable internet, a quiet space, a headset and backup power



To apply

Start your application with the words TWO BRAINS so we know you read this. Include:

1. A 2-minute video or voice note of you selling any service you've sold before (a Loom or unlisted YouTube link is fine)

2. What you sold, your typical deal size and your close rate

3. Your availability between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM Philippine time

title: SENIOR GOHIGHLEVEL EXPERT & DIGITAL OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
NOW HIRING: SENIOR GOHIGHLEVEL EXPERT & DIGITAL OPERATIONS MANAGER



Two Growing U.S. Healthcare & Sports Performance Businesses | Remote | International or U.S. Applicants Welcome



Competitive Compensation | Long-Term Opportunity | Immediate Opening



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL VIRTUAL ASSISTANT POSITION



We are seeking an exceptionally skilled, reliable, proactive Digital Operations Manager to manage the technical systems, marketing infrastructure, CRM platforms, funnels,
 campaigns, and digital operations of two established U.S. businesses:



Perfect Motion Sports Therapy – A premium, cash-based physical therapy and rehabilitation practice.



Velocity RX – A specialized baseball pitching performance, injury prevention, and coaching company serving athletes and families nationwide.



Both companies are led by a physical therapist and performance specialist with over 31 years of experience.



We are actively investing in advertising, marketing, and business growth. We need someone who can take ownership of our digital operations and help us grow.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions. We need someone who understands the objective, knows the technology, anticipates problems, executes accurately, and delivers measurable results.



1. GOHIGHLEVEL – EXPERT LEVEL REQUIRED



You must have extensive, demonstrable experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).



Responsibilities include:



Independently manage two separate GHL subaccounts.



Build, edit, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize sales funnels and landing pages.



Create and manage forms, surveys, calendars, and appointment booking systems.



Build and troubleshoot
 and SMS workflows, automations, triggers, and follow-up sequences.



Manage contact databases, pipelines, opportunities, tagging, and lead tracking.



Configure and troubleshoot
/Meta lead integrations.



Verify that all forms, redirects, calendars, and notifications work correctly.



Implement appointment confirmations, reminders, and missed-appointment follow-ups.



Troubleshoot broken links, incorrect redirects, failed automations, and integration errors.



Create and manage
 templates, branded campaigns, and newsletters.



Perform complete end-to-end testing before publishing any changes.



Maintain existing functional systems without unnecessarily rebuilding or disrupting them.



Document changes and maintain backups or rollback procedures where supported.



Critical requirement: If an advertisement generates a lead, that prospect must be able to complete the entire process, from clicking the advertisement to booking an appointment, without technical failures.



You must know how to verify this independently.



2. WEBSITE, DOMAIN, DNS &
 TECHNICAL MANAGEMENT



We require someone technically proficient who can independently diagnose and resolve common website, domain, and
 configuration problems.



Required experience:



GoDaddy domain and DNS management.



CNAME, A, TXT, MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.



 domain authentication and deliverability.



Mailgun and GHL
 infrastructure.



 click-tracking domains and broken tracking links.



Domain and subdomain connections.



SSL certificates and HTTPS issues.



Website redirects, embedded forms, and booking widgets.



HTML/CSS editing and basic JavaScript troubleshooting.



Third-party integrations, webhooks, and API troubleshooting.



You must understand how to investigate technical errors without requiring the business owner to research the problem and provide you with step-by-step instructions.



You are expected to troubleshoot, identify the cause, implement an appropriate solution, test it, and report the outcome.



3. SIMPLEPRACTICE & HEALTHCARE PRACTICE SUPPORT



Perfect Motion Sports Therapy uses SimplePractice for practice management.



Responsibilities may include:



Administrative support for appointment scheduling and calendar management.



Managing appropriate patient communications and reminders.



Supporting approved intake and administrative workflows.



Coordinating systems and scheduling information where permitted.



Troubleshooting administrative software issues.



Maintaining accurate records and organized workflows.



Healthcare experience is strongly preferred. Familiarity with HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and secure handling of protected health information is important.



Access to patient information will be limited to authorized responsibilities and provided only after appropriate privacy and security onboarding.



4.
 MARKETING & CAMPAIGN EXECUTION



We run ongoing educational, promotional, and client-reactivation campaigns for both businesses.



You will be responsible for:



Building and scheduling weekly
 campaigns.



Creating and maintaining automated
 sequences.



Formatting supplied copy into professional, mobile-responsive
s.



Adding videos, thumbnails, graphics, links, and calls to action.



Managing segmented contact lists and reactivation campaigns.



Testing every link and CTA before scheduling.



Monitoring
 delivery, clicks, replies, and campaign performance.



Troubleshooting
 delivery and technical problems.



Ensuring proper unsubscribe and consent handling.



The business owner frequently provides finished scripts and copy. Your responsibility is to turn that material into professionally executed, functioning campaigns.



5. DIGITAL MARKETING & SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS



We regularly produce educational videos, testimonials, advertisements, and social media content.



Responsibilities include:



Scheduling and publishing approved content on Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.



Creating professional graphics and branded marketing materials.



Basic video editing using tools such as CapCut or Captions.



Uploading and embedding videos using Vimeo or other supported platforms.



Coordinating creative assets with our advertising agency.



Ensuring ad destination links and funnels are functioning.



Maintaining a consistent content calendar.



Tracking campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.



You do not need to be our advertising strategist, but you must understand how advertising, funnels, lead capture, appointment scheduling, and CRM automation work together.



6. PROACTIVE BUSINESS OPERATIONS & PROJECT MANAGEMENT



We need someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes pride in improving the business.



Expectations include:



Maintain an organized task and project management system.



Track assignments, deadlines, priorities, and completion status.



Identify problems before they affect customers or revenue.



Recommend improvements to marketing systems and workflows.



Coordinate with outside vendors and technical support.



Follow up on unresolved technical issues until they are resolved.



Keep both companies' digital assets and systems organized.



Create clear standard operating procedures for recurring tasks.



Identify opportunities to save the owner time and improve business efficiency.



We want a problem solver, not another problem to manage.



7. COMMUNICATION & ACCOUNTABILITY – NONNEGOTIABLE



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



We expect professional, consistent communication and complete transparency regarding work performed.



You must:



Be available and responsive during mutually agreed working hours, with meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Acknowledge assignments promptly.



Communicate immediately when a deadline may be missed.



Notify the owner of technical problems without waiting to be asked.



Provide a written end-of-day report every working day.



Clearly identify completed tasks, outstanding tasks, problems encountered, and next steps.



Provide working links, screenshots, or other evidence of completed technical assignments.



Never mark a task complete until it has been tested and verified.



Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly.



Provide advance notice of planned absences and communicate unexpected emergencies as soon as reasonably possible.



What we will NOT tolerate



Repeated unexplained absences or disappearing during scheduled working hours.



Ignoring messages or failing to provide updates.



Claiming work is complete when it has not been tested.



Missing deadlines without communicating.



Making unauthorized major changes to functioning systems.



Rebuilding funnels or workflows unnecessarily.



Repeated mistakes caused by failing to follow documented instructions.



Waiting for the owner to discover problems.



Excuses instead of solutions.



Inaccurate time reporting or misrepresentation of completed work.



Requiring constant reminders, follow-ups, or micromanagement.



We understand that technical problems happen and emergencies arise. What matters is professional communication, accountability, and responsible resolution.



Reliability is just as important as technical ability.



8. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Minimum 3 years of substantial hands-on GoHighLevel experience, preferably managing multiple business accounts.



Demonstrated ability to build and troubleshoot complete GHL funnels and automations.



Strong experience with DNS, domain management, and
 deliverability.



Experience with GoDaddy or equivalent domain management platforms.



Strong written and spoken English.



Excellent organizational and project management skills.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Strong problem-solving and technical research abilities.



Familiarity with social media scheduling and digital marketing.



Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup communication plan.



Willingness to complete a practical, paid technical assessment.



Preferred qualifications: SimplePractice experience, healthcare administration experience, Meta Ads integration experience, HTML/CSS skills, and experience supporting multiple growing businesses.



9. COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY



We are willing to pay competitive rates for exceptional talent.



Compensation will be based on verified technical expertise, experience, reliability, and scope of responsibility.



We prefer a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to become an integral part of two growing businesses.



We value results, professionalism, initiative, and consistent execution.



Exceptional performance will be recognized and rewarded.



10. HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please provide:



A summary of your GoHighLevel experience, including the number of years and types of systems you have personally built.



Examples or demonstrations of funnels, workflows, or automations you have created.



A description of a difficult GHL, DNS, or
-deliverability problem you personally diagnosed and solved.



Your experience with GoDaddy, Mailgun, and SimplePractice.



Your location, time zone, weekly availability, and ability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Your desired hourly or monthly compensation.



A brief explanation of how you organize tasks, communicate progress, and ensure work is completed correctly.



Begin your application with the words "I TAKE OWNERSHIP" so we know you have read the entire posting.



Generic applications that do not address the technical requirements will not be considered.



FINAL WORD



We are looking for someone who treats our business with the same care and urgency they would treat their own.



If you are technically exceptional, highly dependable, entrepreneurial, and motivated to make a meaningful contribution, we want to hear from you.



If you require constant supervision, struggle with communication, or are uncomfortable being held accountable for results, this is not the position for you.

title: Outbound Cold Caller VA — Kirby Demo Appointment Setter ($4/hr)
description:
Part-time to start (4 hours/day, Mon–Fri), long-term for the right person. US hours (Pacific Time).



We're a Kirby vacuum distributorship in Las Vegas booking in-home floor cleanings. You'll call homeowners from a provided list using our script, qualify interest, and book cleaning appointments. No hard selling — the offer is a free in-home floor cleaning (carpet deep clean, vinyl/laminate power mopping, hardwood buffing, tile and grout scrubbing) at no cost and no pressure.



Responsibilities: Make outbound calls to homeowners from our provided list using our script; Handle basic questions and objections with confidence and warmth; Book qualified demo appointments and log them with name, address, phone, and time; Send daily reports: calls made, conversations, appointments booked; Keep the lead list updated (call outcome, notes, follow-up dates).



Requirements: Fluent English with a clear, neutral accent — must sound natural on the phone; At least 1 year of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience; Your own dialer setup — tell us what dialing system you use; Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet place to call from; Comfortable working Pacific Time hours; Honest daily reporting — we check results, not watch the clock.



What we provide: The call list and the full script; Training on the offer and how appointments get scheduled.



Pay: $4.00/hour to start, paid weekly. Bonuses per booked demo that actually happens — details in the interview.



To apply: Send a 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and reading the script sample below in your natural calling voice. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Sample: 'Hi, this is [your name] calling from Gholston Industries here in Las Vegas. We're offering homeowners a free, no-pressure floor cleaning — carpet deep cleaned, vinyl and laminate micro-swept and power mopped, hardwood buffed back to its shine, or tile and grout scrubbed. Quick question: which room in your home gets the most traffic?'

title: Cold Caller for US Real Estate — Experienced Only (Strict Requirements)
description:
I'm a Keller Williams real estate agent in Massachusetts and Rhode Island hiring ONE experienced cold caller to reach US property owners and set appointments with motivated sellers.



READ THIS FIRST: The requirements below are strict on purpose. If you do not meet EVERY one of them, do not apply — incomplete or unqualified applications are deleted unread.



Pay: $5/hour PLUS $150 for every qualified appointment you set that I attend, PLUS $1,550 for every deal that closes from your appointments. Part-time to start (about 4 hours/day) with a path to full-time for strong performers. All calling happens during US Eastern business hours. Leads, scripts, and dialer access are provided.



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS — ALL of them:

1. Minimum 2 years of cold calling for US real estate (calling homeowners/sellers). General telemarketing, customer service, or inbound call-center work does NOT count.

2. You must have used a power dialer (Mojo, Vulcan7, CallTools, PhoneBurner, or similar) AND a real estate CRM. Name them in your application.

3. Excellent spoken English — US homeowners must understand you easily on the first sentence.

4. Wired internet connection, minimum 25 Mbps, with a speed test screenshot included in your application.

5. Your own computer, quality noise-canceling headset, and a quiet workspace with no background noise on calls.

6. Backup power AND backup internet (generator/UPS and a second connection). State both in your application.

7. No other job that overlaps US Eastern calling hours.

8. You can report your real numbers: calls per day and appointments set per week on your last campaign.



APPLICATIONS ARE CAPPED AT 15. Only the first 15 complete applications will be reviewed — once 15 are in, this posting closes.



How to apply — skip any step and your application is deleted unread:

1. Start your application message with the word CALLSTRONG.

2. Include a 1–2 minute voice recording of a MOCK cold call: your opening line to a homeowner plus how you handle the objection 'I'm not interested.' An introduction recording is not enough.

3. Include your speed test screenshot.

4. Answer in your message: (a) Your US real estate cold-calling experience — how long, which dialer, which CRM? (b) Your numbers from your last campaign: calls/day and appointments/week. (c) Your availability in US Eastern hours. (d) Your backup power and backup internet setup.

5. The strongest applicants will complete a short paid test task (a live mock call) before a final interview.

title: Short-Form Video Clipper (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), Paid on Views, Remote
description:
We're a clipping agency based in LA. We turn long-form content (streams, podcasts, interviews) into short clips and post them on our US pages for paid clipping campaigns. We're hiring clippers to join our team.



HOW IT WORKS

1. Apply using the steps below. We review every application.

2. Shortlisted applicants get a video call with our founder. On the call we assign you to a campaign and walk you through exactly what to clip, the campaign's rules and your daily target.

3. You edit the clips and send them to us. We post them on our US accounts. You don't need your own accounts or followers.

4. You get paid on the views your clips earn.



YOUR TRIAL IS PAID

Your trial lasts as long as your first campaign. Every clip that earns during the trial pays you the same as after it. Clippers who hit their targets and follow the brief stay on the team for the next campaigns.



PAY

- 30% of what each of your clips earns us

- Paid weekly, for earnings the campaign has already paid us

- Paid through the method we agree on during your call



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find the best moments in long streams, podcasts and videos

- Edit vertical clips, 15 to 45 seconds, with strong hooks and clean captions

- Follow each campaign's rules exactly

- Deliver your clips on time, every day



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience editing short-form video (CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar)

- Short clips you've edited that you can show us

- Strong English, so your captions read naturally

- Reliable internet and a steady daily schedule

- Bonus: experience clipping streamers or podcasts, or working on clipping campaigns



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word CLIPPER so we know you read the full post, then send:

1. Links to 3 short clips you've edited

2. The editing software you use

3. Your time zone and how many hours a day you can work

title: Property Manager (New York City experience)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Property Manager to oversee the full-cycle management of a residential rental portfolio in New York City. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing residential rental properties, working with Section 8 (Housing Choice Voucher) programs, and ensuring compliance with New York City and New York State housing regulations.



This role requires a hands-on professional capable of managing all aspects of residential property operations, from tenant acquisition and lease execution to rent collection, maintenance coordination, regulatory compliance, tenant relations, and lease renewals.



The successful candidate must have a strong understanding of NYC rental laws, affordable housing requirements, Section 8 procedures, and the operational demands of managing a residential rental portfolio.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Full-Cycle Property Management

- Oversee the day-to-day operations and full lifecycle management of residential rental properties.

- Manage the leasing process, including property marketing, tenant inquiries, applicant screening, and lease execution.

- Coordinate tenant move-ins, move-outs, inspections, and security deposit administration.

- Manage lease renewals, rent increases, notices, and lease terminations in accordance with applicable laws.

- Maintain accurate property records, tenant files, lease agreements, and operational documentation.

- Monitor occupancy rates, vacancies, rental performance, and property operating expenses.



2. Section 8 & Affordable Housing Management

- Manage properties participating in the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program.

- Coordinate with NYC Housing Authority (NYCHA) and other applicable housing agencies.

- Process Section 8 applications, voucher documentation, rent reasonableness reviews, and Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) contracts.

- Coordinate initial, annual, and follow-up housing inspections.

- Ensure timely submission of required documentation and correction of inspection deficiencies.

- Monitor subsidy payments, tenant portions of rent, recertifications, and changes in household eligibility.

- Maintain compliance with applicable HUD and local affordable housing program requirements.



3. NYC Real Estate Rental Compliance

- Ensure compliance with New York City and New York State residential rental laws and regulations.

- Maintain working knowledge of NYC rent stabilization requirements, where applicable.

- Oversee compliance with applicable HPD, DOB, DHCR, and other regulatory requirements.

- Monitor property registration, required notices, inspections, and housing-related filings.

- Ensure compliance with NYC Housing Maintenance Code, applicable building and safety requirements, and lead-based paint regulations.

- Understand Fair Housing laws, source-of-income discrimination protections, and applicable tenant protections.

- Coordinate responses to regulatory violations, tenant complaints, and agency inquiries.

- Maintain accurate and audit-ready compliance documentation.



4. Rent Collection & Financial Management

- Oversee monthly rent collection, delinquency monitoring, and accounts receivable.

- Track tenant balances, Section 8 subsidy payments, and outstanding receivables.

- Coordinate payment follow-ups and legally compliant rent collection procedures.

- Assist with annual operating budgets, expense tracking, and financial reporting.

- Review property expenses, vendor invoices, and maintenance costs.

- Provide regular reports on rental income, occupancy, arrears, and property performance.



5. Maintenance & Vendor Management

- Coordinate routine, preventive, and emergency maintenance.

- Supervise contractors, vendors, and maintenance personnel.

- Obtain and review vendor estimates and oversee maintenance work.

- Ensure timely resolution of tenant maintenance requests.

- Monitor property conditions and ensure compliance with health and safety standards.

- Coordinate repairs required to satisfy HPD, DOB, and Section 8 inspection requirements.



6. Tenant Relations & Dispute Resolution

- Serve as the primary point of contact for tenants and prospective residents.

- Handle tenant concerns, complaints, lease issues, and maintenance escalations.

- Maintain professional communication with tenants, housing agencies, vendors, and property owners.

- Address lease violations and tenant disputes in accordance with applicable legal procedures.

- Support tenant retention and maintain positive landlord-tenant relationships.



Required Qualifications & Experience



- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in residential property management, preferably within New York City.

- Demonstrated experience managing residential rental properties and overseeing the full leasing and property management cycle.

- Direct experience with Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher programs is required.

- Strong working knowledge of NYC rental regulations and landlord-tenant compliance requirements.

- Experience coordinating NYCHA or other housing authority inspections and documentation.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: KDP Book Production Specialist: Formatting, AI Tools & Quality Control
description:
We are a British publishing company looking for a careful, reliable person to research, create and produce AI-assisted books for Amazon KDP.



You will take books from research to upload-ready files: researching topics, writing and editing with AI tools, proofreading, formatting, quality control, images, covers and A+ Content. This is a hands-on production role. It needs someone who reads instructions closely, keeps track of their own tasks and fixes mistakes without being reminded.



TO SHOW YOU HAVE READ THIS POST, START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "KDP READY".



Responsibilities

- Research book topics, competitors and keywords

- Write and edit books using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini), following our prompts and SOPs

- Manually proofread the full text of each book, up to 30,000 words at times, checking grammar, facts, repeated or missing content and consistency

- Format interiors for paperback, hardcover and eBook (Atticus, Word, Canva)

- Check margins, gutters, bleed, trim size and page count against KDP requirements

- Create interior images and covers with AI tools and Canva

- Build A+ Content and prepare KDP uploads and metadata

- Keep a task list, acknowledge every request and post daily status updates

- Spot problems before publication and suggest fixes



Requirements

- Excellent written English and clear spoken English (we use video calls)

- Very strong attention to detail, with the patience to proofread long texts carefully

- Hands-on formatting experience with Atticus, Word or similar tools

- Comfortable with AI tools, including AI image generation

- Reads instructions carefully, asks when unsure, and does not repeat the same mistake

- Works independently, takes constructive feedback well and takes ownership of errors

- Hours: 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday (currently 5pm to 1am Philippines time), camera on for calls

- Reliable internet and power backup



KDP experience is an advantage but not essential. Strong formatting and attention to detail matter most.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short, paid skills test before any offer.



HOW TO APPLY: Answer every question below in your OWN words. Short, specific answers are better than polished ones. Applications that look copied from ChatGPT or other AI tools will be rejected.



Questions

1. Start with "KDP READY". Where are you located, and are you currently working for another employer or client?



2. Rate yourself from 1 (beginner) to 5 (expert) and say how many years or books you have used each tool for. Write "never used" if that applies.

   - Microsoft Word

   - Canva

   - Atticus

   - Affinity Publisher or Adobe InDesign

   - Kindle Create or Draft2Digital

   - Grammarly or other proofreading tools

   - Any other formatting or design tools



3. Which AI tools do you use right now? For each one, tell us your current plan (free or paid, for example "ChatGPT Plus $20 a month" or "Gemini free") and what you use it for.



4. Have you written or helped write a book or long document with AI, chapter by chapter? Describe your process and how you checked the facts.



5. AI images: which tools have you used, and how do you keep characters and style consistent across a whole book? Share links to examples.



6. Tell us about a real mistake you made at work. What happened, and what did you change afterwards?



7. Your manager says on Tuesday, "Adjust the margins, it's not urgent." On Friday they ask you to check your task list for anything missing. What do you do, and why?



8. List the five checks you would run before publishing a 30,000-word book, in order, and say why the first one is most important.



Please provide

- Resume/CV: open link (no access request needed)

- Portfolio: open link to formatted interiors, covers, Canva work or AI images

- A 60 to 90 second video or voice message (Google Drive, Loom or similar link): introduce yourself and describe one book you worked on



Only applications that answer all questions and include accessible links and the video or voice message will be considered.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to build a career in publishing.

title: Experienced - US Life Insurance - Appointment Setter | $5/hr + Bonus
description:
WHO WE ARE

Shiners Financial is a U.S. life insurance agency that helps families get covered. We want ambitious setters who stay with us for years and book appointments people actually show up to.



THE JOB

You'll call U.S. leads who asked about life insurance, get them on the calendar with our licensed agent, and make sure they're there when the agent calls.



Booking is the whole job. Pricing, products, and coverage questions all go to the agent.



Honestly, this position is driven by your work ethic. Most people you call won't book. Some will hang up on you. If you've done U.S. outbound calling before, you already know that. If you haven't, this probably isn't the job for you.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Dialing leads inside our CRM (lists, time zones, and the dialer are already set up)

- Putting appointments on the agent's calendar

- Reminding people about their appointment so they show up

- Calling back leads who haven't booked yet

- Noting down what happened on every call

- Sending a short recap when your shift ends



PAY AND HOURS

- $5.00 USD an hour (around $1,040 a month)

- $3 extra for every appointment that shows up

- Room to increase your rate based on performance

- Paid twice a month

- Monday to Saturday, 8 hours a day

- 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern

  That's 10:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila from November to March,

  and 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM Manila from March to November

- Full-time and long-term



If you're good at this and you stick around, there's room to move into training and hiring new setters as we grow.



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years making outbound calls to U.S. customers (setting appointments, telemarketing, or sales)

- Fluent English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent (U.S. callers should understand you the first time)

- Your own laptop or desktop, Core i5 or better with 8GB RAM. Phones and tablets won't work.

- 25 Mbps or faster internet, and a second connection ready if it drops

- A way to keep working when the power goes out

- A noise-canceling USB headset and a quiet room

- No other job during our hours

- A working webcam & able to get on a Zoom call with your camera on (if needed)



NICE TO HAVE

- Final expense or mortgage protection calling experience

- Time on a dialer or CRM (GoHighLevel, Ringy, ReadyMode, etc)

- You've worked U.S. night shift before



YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU

- Want to stay somewhere long-term instead of hopping jobs

- Can hear "no" all day and still sound good on the next call

- Like getting paid more when your appointments show up

- Are open to coaching and following a script



HOW HIRING WORKS

1. We go through applications and watch every video

2. You do a few paid trial shifts on real leads

3. If it's a fit, we make you a full-time offer



HOW TO APPLY

If you skip any of these steps, we won't review your application.



1. Start your application with the word LEGACY.



2. Send us a short video, 3 minutes or less, with your camera on. Record it where you'd actually work, with the headset you'd use. Upload it to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or Google Drive and paste the link. Make sure we can open it. If you're not sure how to do any of this, figuring it out is part of the test.



In the video:

- Introduce yourself

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience, especially life insurance

- Tell us which dialers, CRMs, or other systems you've used

- Tell us how many appointments you usually set per day or per week, and your show rate if you know it

- Read this like it's a real call:



"Hi, is this Mary? Hi Mary, this is [your name] calling about the life insurance information you asked for. I'll be quick. I just want to set up a short call with our licensed agent so they can go over your options. Would tomorrow at 2 PM or Thursday at 10 AM work better for you?"



- Then pretend Mary says: "Just send me something in the mail." Show us what you'd say next. No script for this part.



3. In the message you send with your application, answer these:

- Can you work this shift, Monday to Saturday, for at least a year?

- Do you have another job right now?

- What do you do if the power or internet goes out?

- Run a speed test at speedtest.net and paste the link to your result
